assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 轨道保护区、站城一体化控制条件与控规指标未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls (railway protection zone, FAR, height) are unknown; this proposal makes no numeric conclusions about them.

assumptions.statement_zh: 公交IC卡、共享单车与客流数据仅作概念性匿名聚合引用，不替代官方统计，不涉及任何真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Transit-card and crowd data are referenced as anonymous aggregates only; no real individuals are identified.

assumptions.statement_zh: 智核集散广场、AI出行服务大厅与智慧换乘走廊设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 出行与客流数据仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Mobility data uses anonymous aggregation with human review; no irreversible automated decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 通勤周、开放日与分期实施等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排、轨道运营方承诺或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or operator commitments.
